title: Iranian, Lebanese FM hold talks on sidelines of OIC summit in Baghdad

title: Iranian, Turkish foreign ministers meet on sidelines of OIC summit in Baghdad
body: Tehran, IRNA – Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi met his Turkish counterpart Hakan Fidan in Baghdad on Saturday on the sidelines of the 52nd Council of Foreign Ministers of the Organization of Islamic Cooperation (OIC).

title: Second supertanker explodes after hitting mine in Strait of Hormuz: IRGC Navy

title: Leader congratulates Iran’s U23 Greco-Roman wrestling team on world title

title: Iran rejects pressure, remains open to dialogue: Araghchi
body: Tehran, IRNA – Iran will not surrender its sovereign rights under pressure but remains ready for dialogue based on mutual respect and credible guarantees, Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said on Saturday.
